# PDF.js 6.5.438

Vendored from the official Mozilla pdfjs-dist npm package. The main and worker modules use the unmodified legacy/build compatibility distribution so browsers without the newest built-in APIs can still extract text. Used only for local transcript text extraction; no PDF is uploaded to a service.

Upstream: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases/tag/v6.5.438

The npm tarball was verified against its SHA-512 integrity before extraction. provenance.json records the source, tarball integrity and SHA-256 of each unmodified file. Matching main and worker versions must be updated together. LICENSE is Apache-2.0; CMap/font license files are preserved.
